inputs.text: Photorealistic restrained cinematic realism in the same cold blue hospital corridor. The slim East Asian father remains in the exact stable one-knee kneeling posture shown in the input image: left knee on the floor, right foot planted, torso inclined toward his daughter's untied right sneaker. Hero motion, very small amplitude and slow speed: he settles his weight downward by only two centimeters, exhales once with a subtle shoulder drop, lowers his gaze from the child to the untied shoelace, and ends completely still with both hands near his thighs. The five-year-old daughter remains seated and almost motionless, looking down. Her untied right sneaker stays unchanged: one short lace end rests softly along the outer shoe side and curves downward, while the longer lace end hangs freely below the toe in a relaxed asymmetric curve under gravity; the lace tips point downward and never float or stiffen. Her other sneaker remains tied. Preserve the father's face, short black side-parted hair, dark charcoal blazer, light gray crew-neck shirt and black trousers. Preserve the daughter's bob haircut, teal puffer jacket, mustard backpack, gray leggings and white sneakers. Chair positions, corridor architecture and fluorescent lighting remain unchanged. Locked static camera, no speech, no scene cut.
